Title: Vikram's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Vikram - 31 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Kavita - 55 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The office - Day

[Vikram stands in the office. Kavita stands near him.]

Vikram: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Vikram has a heart attack at his desk.]

Vikram: "What happened?"

[Vikram answers the phone at his desk.]

Kavita: "Okay, Vikram."

[Vikram stretches after hours at the computer.]

Kavita: "Yes, all right."

[Vikram presents the chart and points at the screen.]

Vikram: "Oh wow!"

[Vikram shakes hands with the new client.]

Vikram: "That's easy."

[Vikram presses the lift button and waits.]

Kavita: "That's great!"

[Vikram checks his watch impatiently.]

Vikram: "This is amazing!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Vikram stands in the living room. Kavita stands near him.]

Vikram: "What a nice place."

[Vikram is dying to see the new film.]

Vikram (laughing): "That was fun!"

[Vikram plays dead to fool his sister.]

Vikram: "Hmm, I see."

[The doorbell rings; Vikram opens the door and takes the parcel.]

Kavita: "How beautiful!"

[Vikram laughs out loud at the comedy film.]

Vikram: "That was fun!"

[Vikram jumps in his seat at the scary scene.]

Vikram (softly): "Hmm, I see."

[Vikram coughs in the thick smoke and crawls to the door.]

Kavita: "Hmm, I see."

[Vikram throws a bucket of water on the fire.]

Vikram: "Really?"

Scene 3: The hospital ward - Day

[Vikram stands in the ward. Kavita stands near him.]

Vikram: "So, here we are!"

[Mother passes away, and Vikram covers her body with a white sheet.]

Vikram (excited): "No… this cannot be!"
